title: Industrial Forge
body:
"Whew.. It's literally on fire! Use this to turn refined material into shiny, sparkly, ingots!"

Description

The Industrial Forge is the third and final tier of forges. It can be found and purchased at The Oak Depot. Like the Rusty Forge and Metal Forge, It is used to smelt refined ores/rocks (which can be done through a refinery) into forged ingots/rocks by putting them through its conveyor, but can smelt larger ores/rocks than the previous two.

Appearance

The forge bears a similar look to the Metal Forge, being made with a dark metal and having frames on the sides, but with red lines along it, and a grate that lets out smoke from the side of the forge.
